notes.title: Spanish version has released!!
notes.notes:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26355520/00915d0d4fa20838c56283c74fde03511ae1d8fd.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26355520/45bd7f4b5b1300a183e34bfbe8e52ff0121a33d0.png[/img][/url]

Dear Spanish speaking Comrades,

With great help of [b]Sharin-Sub[/b], we released Spanish version of HEBEREKE!

Sorry, Spanish savedata is not compatible with Japanese savedata.
If you already installed the Japanese version, you need to uninstall it, clear save files, before installing Spanish version.

In case you are running non-Spanish system, and want to try Spanish version, choose Spanish in the language tab of the HEBEREKE! property 

Now we are fully working on the English version.
Thank you for waiting!
